stills.caption: On the third Wednesday of September the town bulletin board carries the mod's notice, dated by the game.
All day, villagers open with a line about the fair from the mod's calendar.json.
Then the villager carries on in their own words: the fair line comes first, nothing of the game's is lost.

film.caption: The Harvest Fair notice on the bulletin board, then Twiggy talking about the fair before her usual chat.
